title: Where a Tuya or Smart Life Matter code is
description: Tuya based devices pair with the QR code on the device or the 11 digit pairing code, and share from the Tuya or Smart Life app with a one time, time limited sharing code. Zigbee devices behind a Tuya gateway share through the gateway.
lede: Tuya powers many white label brands, so the sticker's spot varies by product. What stays the same is the app: it pairs with the printed code and shares with a temporary one.

rows.text: Plus, Scan, then scan the QR code on the device or enter the 11 digit pairing code.

The device, the three dot menu, Share Device, then Share over Matter for a code or Share with QR Code. Tuya: the sharing code is one time use and time limited, and the pairing code and sharing code are different; the pairing code is used for the initial activation.
Those devices have no Matter code of their own. Share the gateway instead, with Share via Matter Gateway.
Because the label belongs to the white label brand, the printed location varies per product. Check the device, its box and its leaflet.
